name: support-digest
description: Builds a support digest for a period (default the last 7 days) from your support desk: ticket volume with day-by-day counts and the change against the previous period, the top themes with counts, SLA breaches (first reply and resolution, including tickets still waiting), the worst offenders, top customers by volume and the backlog. Every number, date and breach is computed in code from ticket timestamps; the model only labels ticket subjects into themes. SLA targets come from the desk's policies, else from stated defaults. Filters by tier, customer or priority. Read-only: it never changes a ticket. Works on pasted tickets when no support desk is connected. Not a ticket triager, not a reply drafter and not an escalation predictor.

skills.name: Support digest: volume, themes and SLA breaches
skills.description: Reports support ticket volume and its trend, the top themes and the SLA breaches for a period, with every number computed in code.
examples: Which tickets breached SLA this week?
